analysis.title_zh: AlphaEarth Foundations：以统一地球观测表征支持精细制图与监测
analysis.summary: 【官方公告】2025年7月30日，官方介绍了AlphaEarth Foundations，将其定位为类似“虚拟卫星”的AI模型。它整合拍字节级地球观测数据，生成统一数据表征，旨在应对观测数据复杂、多模态且持续更新带来的整合难题，适用于全球制图与监测，覆盖地球全部陆地及近岸水域。所给节选未提供量化评测、具体操作方法或开放使用信息。[S1]
analysis.application: 建议：【你的推断】可探索将统一地球观测表征用于基础设施周边环境监测及可靠性研究中的环境暴露特征构建；这些属于科研迁移设想，并非官方已验证用途。【官方公告】原文称模型能够准确、高效地表征陆地和近岸水域，但所给节选没有评测数据，无法判断已验证效果的幅度。[S1]
evidence: New AI model integrates petabytes of Earth observation data to generate a unified data representation that revolutionizes global mapping and monitoring
While this data has been incredibly impactful, its complexity, multimodality and refresh rate creates a new challenge: connecting disparate datasets and making use of them all effectively.
Today, we’re introducing AlphaEarth Foundations, an artificial intelligence (AI) model that functions like a virtual satellite.
It accurately and efficiently characterizes the planet’s entire terrestrial land and coastal waters by integrating huge amounts of Earth observation data
